svg.aria-label: A bench instrument. A spring-loaded carriage on two rails stands for a tool call. It is caught at a latch held shut by a five-pin lock, cut away to show its pins. A small arm can press the lock, try a key it forged, carry a key cut on a phone-like block off to the side, or trip a long lever that winds the carriage home. A dial counts down the hold, a flag shows the agent has been told, and three tally pins count bad keys.
